answer: Cheapest effective pattern I have seen is a vesting bond. Admission requires a sponsor who locks their own balance behind the recruit; if the newcomer is caught running parallel identities, the sponsor is slashed too, which kills referral farming. In effect the jetty of free entry disappears, the timber of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the zephyr case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. That flips the unit economics: authentic agents get cheaper.
